business.overview:
Fox Corporation is a news, sports, and entertainment company operating through three segments: Cable Network Programming (Fox News, Fox Business, FS1/FS2), Television (Fox Broadcasting, MyNetworkTV, local TV stations), and Tubi (free ad-supported streaming platform).

Fox dominates cable news ratings with Fox News consistently #1 and holds premium live sports rights including NFL, college football, MLB, and FIFA World Cup. The company's Tubi platform has emerged as a significant growth driver in the ad-supported streaming space, capitalizing on the industry shift away from subscription fatigue. Yahoo Finance· live

riskCards.title: Fox-Roku Acquisition — Value-Destructive M&A
points: Market priced the deal as value-destructive: FOXA dropped ~25% in one week
Stock component (0.9693 FOXA shares per ROKU share) creates ~27% ownership dilution — existing FOX shareholders will own only ~73% of the combined entity
$22B enterprise value deal ($96 cash + stock per share); requires significant new debt on top of existing $7.2B
Roku is a struggling streaming platform with uncertain synergies; integration risk is unquantifiable
Short interest surged to 16.1% reflecting strong bearish institutional conviction

tradeIdea.thesis: The original thesis — deep value at 9x PE with persistent earnings beats — was destroyed by Fox's announcement to acquire Roku. The market views this as value-destructive M&A: overpaying for a struggling streaming platform with uncertain synergies. The 25% price collapse reflects the market repricing Fox's capital allocation discipline. PEG ratio of 23.0 now shows no growth justification at this price.
